name: BOOoop.

categories.label: Won the game
categories.hint: Tick the winner: 3 Cats in a row, or all 8 of your Cats on the bed.

winCondition: First player to line up 3 Cats in a row (orthogonal or diagonal), or to have all 8 of their Cats on the bed at once, wins.

endCondition.description: Game ends immediately when a player meets a win condition (checked after all booped pieces finish moving).

notes: family: objective-only. BOOoop. is the boop. edition with Ghost Cats (which can boop Cats across gaps); exact Ghost Cat win rules could not be read from the publisher rulebook, so only the base boop. win conditions are modelled. Verify Ghost Cat additions against the official rulebook.
